sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: 📊 dropdown, with the "MusicBrainz: Instrument Icons Everywhere" userscript (@Lotheric) installed: a value entry whose cell shows one instrument's icon, and every "» instrument:" entry, shows that icon after its label (new setting "Show Instrument Icons In Unique-Values Dropdown", sa_enable_dropdown_instrument_icons, on by default, no effect without the userscript). A new "Instrument info - Icon" section (🎻) counts and filters the rows whose instrument links have / lack an icon (modes ii-icon-yes / ii-icon-no, _highlightInstrumentIconMatch()), on any column that holds an instrument link — e.g. "Name" on an instrument search, where neither existed before.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: With the "MusicBrainz: Instrument Icons Everywhere" userscript (@Lotheric) installed, the release "Instruments" column, a credit's "(instrument)" annotation and the instrument list's "Name" column lost every instrument icon: they copied the instrument link alone, so the copy kept the userscript's data-ii-processed stamp but not the icon in front of it, and the userscript never decorates a stamped link again. Links are now copied with their icon (_cloneInstrumentAnchorWithIcon()); an icon-less copy is handed back to the userscript (_iiReleaseIconlessAnchors()), and an icon that arrives after the table is built is carried onto the source row so it survives sorting and filtering (_iiInstallIconReconciler(), _iiMirrorLateIcons()). Nothing changes without that userscript.
